spec.description: Monitor SUDO Logs with JSON Logging

spec.expr: {host=~"$host", unit=~"user@.*service"} |= `COMMAND=` | pattern `<sudoer>:<message>TTY=<tty> ; PWD=<pwd> ; USER=<user> ; COMMAND=<command>` | line_format `{"sudoer": "{{.sudoer|trim}}", "pwd": "{{.pwd}}", "user": "{{.user|trim}}", "command": "{{.command}}", "message": "{{.message|trim}}"}` | json sudoer="sudoer", user="user", message="message" | message =~ `\s*` | __error__=``

count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"user@.*service"} |= `COMMAND=` | pattern `<sudoer>:<message>TTY=<tty> ; PWD=<pwd> ; USER=<user> ; COMMAND=<command>` | line_format `{"sudoer": "{{.sudoer|trim}}", "pwd": "{{.pwd}}", "user": "{{.user|trim}}", "command": "{{.command}}", "message": "{{.message|trim}}"}` | json sudoer="sudoer", user="user", message="message" | message != `` [$__auto])

topk(10, sum by (sudoer, command) (count_over_time({host=~"$host", unit=~"user@.*service"} |= `COMMAND=` | pattern `<sudoer>:<message>TTY=<tty> ; PWD=<pwd> ; USER=<user> ; COMMAND=<command>` | line_format `{"sudoer": "{{.sudoer|trim}}", "pwd": "{{.pwd}}", "user": "{{.user|trim}}", "command": "{{.command}}", "message": "{{.message|trim}}"}` | json sudoer="sudoer", user="user", message="message" | message !~ `\s*` | __error__=`` [$__range])))
